title: In the Hand of Dante
plot_overview: A Vatican priest discovers what may be Dante’s original Divine Comedy manuscript and seeks help authenticating it. A literary expert becomes entangled in a dangerous criminal scheme involving the priceless text, while a parallel historical story follows Dante’s spiritual and creative struggle to complete his masterpiece.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like ambitious, atmospheric literary thrillers with crime, romance, spirituality, and a large cast; Not for you if you prefer concise, straightforward stories with consistent pacing.
review_summary: Pros: striking visuals; ambitious ideas; memorable cast | Cons: uneven pacing; confusing story; self-important tone
